filterPolicy.description: Includes successful HTTP 200 GET requests to numeric SLC item routes. First remove explicitly recognized bots, crawlers, and scanners; then group remaining requests by IP address + User-Agent and exclude ALL requests from identities with 63 or more distinct catalog item IDs. Identities with 62 distinct entries remain included. These are historical HTTP page requests, not intentional entry clicks or confirmed human activity.
